** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Replace the retired model `gemini-1.5-flash`. The feature cannot return AI output with it.** Google's Gemini API release notes list `gemini-1.5-flash` as shut down on September 29, 2025. Requests that use a retired model name return a 404 error. `GeminiAiService` reads this default through `getString('gemini_model_name')`. Every real request therefore gets a non-2xx response. The service logs `ai_error` and returns the fallback meal with `isAiGenerated: false`. The unit tests use `MockClient`, so they cannot detect this. Users never see Gemini output. Use a currently supported model. Update these places: - This default. - `_defaultModel` in `mobile/lib/services/gemini_ai_service.dart` (Line 18). - The model text in `docs/ai-feature.md` (Line 72). Also set the Remote Config value in the Firebase console.

After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```

** Major** · **Security & Privacy** · ** Detected with Advanced Tier** · **Heavy lift** **Sensitive Data Exposure** **Reachability:** External **Exploitability:** Moderate **CWE:** [CWE-798](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html) — Use of Hard-coded Credentials [View Security blast radius](https://app.coderabbit.ai/change-stack/ruxenb/LongvitaRC/pull/36/blast-radius?scope=ghh_OusAJGA4HG8ljoOV0wJvVx8NmnZIjc2DdjmxOu0xZWA&toCommitId=fe86a64e6ff39eb05062c42413a533c08ac11dc0&reviewRunId=7aac68de-9d8f-4556-a59f-62a9c9e66a98&securityFinding=1a28a5eefae0207fa91164c7) **Do not ship the Gemini API key inside the client app, and do not put it in the URL.** `String.fromEnvironment('GEMINI_API_KEY')` compiles the key into the app binary as a string constant. The app then sends it as the `?key=` query parameter. An attacker who has the APK or IPA can extract the key. They can then call the Gemini API with it and use your quota and billing. Query-string keys can also appear in proxy, crash, and network logs. Route the call through a backend or a Firebase service that keeps the key on the server. Examples are a Cloud Function or Firebase AI Logic with App Check. If a client-side key is unavoidable, send it in the `x-goog-api-key` header. Restrict the key to the Gemini API and to your app's package and signature. Also applies to: 85-87

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Use a distinct error type for an unusable 2xx response.** When the status is 2xx but the body has no text or fails parsing, the code reaches `_logAiError('http_${response.statusCode}', ...)`. This logs `http_200` and sets the reason to `HTTP error 200`. The analytics data then shows a successful HTTP call as an error. Log a separate type, for example `parse_failed`, when the status is 2xx.

** Minor** · **Stability & Availability** · **Quick win** **Handle the asynchronous failure of `logEvent` in `_logAiError`.** `_logAiError` is synchronous and does not await `_analytics?.logEvent(...)`. The `try/catch` catches only synchronous throws. If the returned `Future` fails, the error is unhandled. This method runs inside the fallback paths, so the failure is reported through the zone error handler. Make the method `async` and `await` the call. You can also add `.catchError` to the call and wrap it in `unawaited`.

Committable suggestion

> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion Future _logAiError(String errorType, String mealType) async { try { await _analytics?.logEvent( name: 'ai_error', parameters: { 'error_type': errorType, 'meal_type': mealType.toLowerCase(), }, ); } catch (_) { // Non-fatal } } ```

body:
** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Reject incomplete Gemini output instead of filling fabricated nutrition values.** `fromJson` replaces every missing field with an invented default. Examples are `calories: 400`, `proteinGrams: 12.0`, `ingredients: []`, `confidenceScore: 0.95`, and a placeholder `mealName`. `_parseStructuredJson` then sets `isAiGenerated: true` and the Gemini `sourceNote`. A response such as `{}` or `{"mealName": "x"}` returns a recommendation that the app shows as AI-generated Gemini output with made-up nutrition data. The service never reaches `AiMealRecommendation.fallback`. Validate the required fields (`mealName`, `calories`, `ingredients`) in `_parseStructuredJson`. Return `null` when they are missing or out of range, for example `calories <= 0`. The service then uses the deterministic fallback. Keep the defaults only for non-critical fields.
